key_insight: Full Transformers do not just avoid rank collapse; they selectively amplify structured token patterns such as waves, rotations, and clusters through their architecture.
engineering_relevance: This suggests you can improve data efficiency and optimization by aligning positional encoding and initialization with the pattern dynamics a task should favor.
method: Uses pattern-formation theory to analyze Transformer forward-pass dynamics.
Studies how positional encoding, multi-head attention, and output-value geometry shape which patterns grow or stabilize.
Compares patterns that compete, coexist, or become amplified in full Transformer architectures.
evidence_signal: The paper reports improved data efficiency and faster optimization on controlled sequence tasks, and also shows benefits with ConViT on CIFAR-10.
watch_item: The controllable dynamical-prior view depends on careful architectural choices, so gains may be sensitive to positional encoding design and initialization.
